description: Screen one person or company against the sanctions and watchlists on the caller's Verifex plan. Uses one screening from the plan's quota. Sends only the name, type, country and date of birth. The result starts with a status line written by this server: report it word for word. A potential match is not a confirmed match; zero matches cover only the lists named in the result; an incomplete screening must never be reported as clear.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code of nationality, residence or registration, e.g. AE, DE, RU.

date_of_birth.description: YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. People only; narrows the candidates.

name.description: Full name of the person or company, on one line.

type.description: person, or entity for a company or organisation.

name: screen_name
title: Screen a person or company
